item.title: Burnham ‘personally intervened’ over possible early prison release of grooming gang perpetrators
item.summary: Government ‘urgently’ identifying men convicted in historical cases who could be freed in scheme loophole UK politics live – latest updates Andy Burnham’s government is “urgently” identifying any grooming gang perpetrators who may still be eligible for early prison release after concerns were raised about a potential loophole in the system. The prime minister has “personally intervened” after men convicted of assaulting children in Bradford were expected to be freed from prison early despite a promise earlier this week that they would remain behind bars.
